notes.title: Lots of bugfixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Many issues with the lighting system have been fixed.
[*] Shurikens no longer get stuck in mid-air.
[*] Spirits at Sakura's park that spawn outside, are now redirected inside.
[*] Some softlock situations have been patched.
[/list]

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Collision bugs in some scenes.
[*] Small graphics glitches.
[*] Other minor issues.
[/list]

notes.title: Episode 3 released!
notes.content:
Flatworld Episode 3 has been released. We have reached the 60% of the adventure.

This new update adds the following:

- 4-5 hours of the main adventure
- 2 cities (+ 1 in ruins)
- 1 dungeon
- 2 new playable characters with unique abilities
- 5 key items for the inventory
- 1 final boss + many mid-bosses
- 5 equipable badges
- 6 sidequests
- 3 new bestiary cards
- 4 items to customize your characters
- Magic crystals to teleport around the world
- Healthbar for the enemies (optional)
- 11 badge points
- 6 Steam achievements
- Bugfixes and small improvements

notes.title: More improvements and bugfixes
notes.content:
Improvements:

[list]
[*] Now while playing a flute, the interface shows which buttons you can use.
[*] During boat races, now the floor shows the shape of the circuit to avoid becoming lost.
[*] Walking speed when using the light spell has been increased.
[*] When using the light spell on a crystal, now a popup appears showing the buttons for aiming.
[*] Mole's hitbox when being hurt by a boulder from Yami is now larger.
[/list]

Fixed bugs:

[list]
[*] A few players used to lose their minecart in the room where you switch tracks using the waitress.
[*] Flute sound now depends on the SFX volume from the game settings.
[*] Light spell allowed to go through the triggers which showed cinematics, letting you skip them.
[*] Other minor bugfixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Difficulty improvements
notes.content:
Changes:

[list]
[*] Now fire monsters are slower.
[*] Also, their hitbox has been fixed.
[*] Lewis now hits the wall easier in his boss battle.
[*] Other minor bugfixes.
[/list]

Thank you for your support and feedback. More updates will be done in the next days to improve the game experience.

notes.title: Episode 2 bugfixes
notes.content:
Bugfixes:

- Some chests were already open by default.
- Some menu descriptions have now their right text.
- Softlock when using the steam machine and then leaving the room without finishing the puzzle.
- Some parts of the game didn't pause when opening the menu.
- Boat race checkpoint collisions have been shrunk.
- Other minor bugs.

Design improvements for a better understanding of the following points:

- Coltan Mine music puzzle.
- Starting arguments at the restaurant.

We will keep updating the game to provide a better experience. Thank you for your feedback and support.

notes.title: Big update with new content
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improved narrative.
[*] More interaction with the environment.
[*] 5 new side quests.
[*] 1 new achievement.
[*] 1 new equippable badge to run faster.
[*] 3 new items (2 mission items and 1 special).
[/list]

notes.title: Lots of improvements in game experience
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Now battle music only plays when you hit a monster or you get hit.
[*] Now you can break ice balls thrown during the Ice Castle boss battle.
[*] New introduction scene.
[*] The flashback about how Aki arrived to Flatworld is now shown just after he recovers from amnesia after seeing the helicopter, to make the main plot easier to understand.
[*] That same flashback is now a little larger.
[*] Some cinematic dialogues have been improved to make the plot more understandable.
[*] Sprinklers can be shot from more distance.
[*] If you blow up a pyrotechnics box accidentally, the rocket on it will still set off to avoid missing it because of your mistake.
[*] Credits added at the end of Episode 1 to give a better feeling of ending.
[*] The amount of money you can obtain in each dungeon has been limited (vases and enemies).
[*] Now vases always contain hearts in boss battles.
[*] Lots of bugfixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Improvements in dungeons, bosses and cinematics + bugfixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Oasis dungeon orientation has been improved.
[*] The clue for beating Oasis boss is now clearer.
[*] Mori city has been polished a little bit.
[*] Episode 1 final boss end cinematic has been modified for better understanding.
[*] Many bugfixes.
[/list]

Thank you for your feedback. You're helping a lot :)

notes.title: Oasis Dungeon less annoying and bugfixes
notes.content:
Oasis Dungeon:

[/list]

Bugfixes:

[list]
[*] Solved compatibility with Dualshock 2 and 4.
[*] Bug in the Slime puzzle (it left the path to follow) solved.
[*] Other minor bugfixes.
[/list]

notes.title: First bugfixes update
notes.content:
These are the bugs that have been fixed:

[list]
[*] Dice battle is now less frustrating.
[*] Issue with French systems has been solved.
[*] Slime puzzle in Ice Castle does not get stuck anymore.

[*] Some other minor bugfixes.
[/list]
